name: Mastiff
_comment: SRD 5.2.1 (CC-BY-4.0), Mastiff. AC 12 is 10 + Dex 2 with no armour; Bite +3 and 1d6 + 1 from Strength and PB +2; Perception +5 is Wis 1 with Expertise; the Wisdom save +3 is proficiency. The Bite knocking a Medium or smaller target Prone is effect.monster.knock_prone_on_bite. Darkvision and the senses are out of scope. A working dog, so the townsfolk faction.
